facts.text: I have trouble sleeping at the times I'd prefer.

My sleep problem is putting a strain on my marriage.
I've tried using caffeine to fix my sleep pattern.

leakage.reason: Generic word 'sleep' ('my sleep pattern'): the patient's own complaint is about sleep; no diagnostic term ('advanced', 'phase') is used.
Generic word 'sleep' ('trouble sleeping'): the patient's own complaint; not the diagnosis.
Generic word 'sleep' in the item 'unrefreshing sleep': a standard symptom label; not the diagnosis.
Generic word 'sleep' ('the sleep problem'): the patient's own complaint; not the diagnosis.
Generic word 'sleep' ('my sleep problem'): the patient's own complaint; not the diagnosis.
Polysomnography result says 'advanced sleep phase' (the core of the gold diagnosis); it is the test's answer.
Melatonin result says 'consistent with advanced sleep phase disorder' (gold diagnosis verbatim); it is the test's answer (pool flag: test_results).

source_issues: The polysomnography leaf names the diagnosis verbatim (pool_flags.visible_gold_alias_partitions = test_results) and also contains a melatonin result, which is not part of polysomnography.
objective_for_doctor names the diagnostic category ('with a focus on identifying circadian rhythm sleep disorders').
notes: The polysomnography leaf (i001) is split into two ordered tests: polysomnography and melatonin level, both citing i001.
Sleep-timing complaints use system 'neurological' (the schema has no sleep system).
The failed caffeine attempt is a child of the evening sleepiness (attribute relieving, polarity absent = caffeine does not relieve it), not a separate caffeine-use habit.
'Feeling rested upon waking' is written as the finding 'unrefreshing sleep' absent.
Retirement from the day-shift cemetery job is the occupation fact; the inability to share evening activities with his wife and the marital strain are separate social facts.

check_coverage warns that the polysomnography aliases ('sleep study', 'overnight sleep study') contain the gold word 'sleep'. These are the standard clinical names of the test and do not reveal the diagnosis, so they are kept.
Fixes: f013 new fact 'marital status' from f012; f014 new fact 'caffeine use' from f002.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with trouble sleeping, with a focus on identifying circadian rhythm sleep disorders.
